name: Progress
description: Progress as a bar, a ring or named steps, from two mapped fields (current and total) or fixed values, with optional warning / good thresholds.

props.name: current_value
props.label: Current
props.description: Used when the Current context entry is not mapped.

props.name: total_value
props.label: Total
props.description: Used when the Total context entry is not mapped. For Steps, the number of steps.

props.name: steps
props.label: Step names
props.description: For the Steps style, in order (e.g. Submitted, Review, Approval, Done). Current may be the step number (1 = first) or its name.

props.name: warn_below
props.label: Warn below (%)
props.description: Below this percentage the progress uses the error colour and says Needs attention.

props.name: good_above
props.label: Good from (%)
props.description: From this percentage the progress uses the success colour and says On track.

context.name: current
context.label: Current
context.description: The field with the progress so far (a number, a step number or name, or a list whose length counts).

context.name: total
context.label: Total
context.description: The field with the target or total (a number, or a list whose length counts).

accessibility.keyboard: Display only: nothing to operate. Bar and ring are a progressbar with the label and percentage as aria-valuetext; Steps is an ordered list with the current step marked aria-current="step" ("Step 2 of 5: Review").

author: UserTasks
